The document 'TECH BYTE(SIH 2026).pdf' outlines a proposal for a Sovereign On-Premise Agentic AI Workbench designed for confidential industrial data processing. The workbench aims to bring AI capabilities to industrial environments without exposing data to external clouds, ensuring data privacy and security. The proposed solution includes a secure, on-premise deployment with local models (like Llama, Qwen) for processing various data types including PDFs, images, and tables. The workbench uses an RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) pipeline to fetch relevant context from a vector store, enabling the use of domain-specific knowledge and local tools for tasks such as calculations and document analysis. The workbench is designed to be scalable, modular, and secure, with features like local authentication, access control, and a sandbox environment for safe code execution. The document also discusses the challenges and mitigation strategies for implementing such a system in real-world industrial environments, including limitations like GPU constraints and the need for task-specific models. The key benefits of the proposed solution include improved productivity, reduced manual effort, and enhanced compliance and transparency. The workbench is designed to be compliant with regulatory requirements and to support sustainable operations. [Source 1]
